summaryZh: Raju 实验室研究新发 RNA 病毒的致病性和免疫保护，关注 B 细胞、T 细胞及病毒致病所需的宿主分子。团队使用细胞、分子和结构生物学工具。
researchQuestions: 由B细胞和T细胞等关键细胞介导的抗病毒保护性免疫如何实现？
topics: 宿主与病原体相互作用

evidence.quote: We study immunity to and pathogenicity of emerging RNA viruses using tools in cellular, molecular, and structural biology Welcome to the Raju Lab! The major goal of the lab is train and educate the next-generation of scientists. We will accomplish this aim by working on fun and fundamental problems in biology. Along the way we expect to contribute to the field of viral immunology and possibly others… We are interested in the molecular interactions between pathogens and their respective hosts. These interactions reveal fundamental aspects of biology that can be quite unexpected! A major component of the laboratory is to study how immunity is achieved against viruses with a particular focus on B and T cells as key cell types mediating protective immunity. We also identify and characterize key host molecules required for viral pathogenesis. Studying these interactions provides insight into tissue and species tropism of viruses a key feature of what makes them unique. Learn MORE → MEET the PI → Publications → Lab News April 29,2026: Saran is named a Searle Scholar . Many thanks to the Kinship Foundation for the support! April 8, 2026: Saran’s last manuscript from his postdoc is published in Science Translational Medicine . In this paper, we performed structure-guided mutagenesis and antibody scaffolding to generate a pan-encephalitic alphavirus decoy molecule. Thanks to Sathvik and Mike for pushing this one through! April 1, 2026: Jonah Mansky (UCSD, Class of 2029) joins the lab as an undergraduate researcher. March 1, 2026: Surovi Mohona joins the laboratory as a postdoctoral research fellow. Surovi completed her PhD at Loyola University Chicago in Tom Gallagher’s laboratory. She has a very cool story regarding coronavirus assembly on BioRxiv ( Link to Preprint) January 5, 2026: Chris Bridges (BMS PhD student) joins the lab for his winter rotation October 1, 2026: Yaneli Guerra (BMS PhD student) joins the lab for her first rotation September 15, 2025: Several undergraduates join the lab including Nicole Liu, Qiman Hu, Kevin Ma, and Grayce Coletta September 1, 2025: Sinclair Chieng (UCSD ’25) joins the lab as an SRA. July 1, 2025: The laboratory is open, we are recruiting technicians, graduate students, and postdocs to the Raju Lab!
